name: Acesulfame potassium
aliases: E950, acesulfame K, acesulfame potassium, acesulfamo K, acesulfamo potásico
what_is: A calorie-free synthetic intense sweetener about 200 times sweeter than sucrose.
why_botia: It flags it because it is an artificial sweetener characteristic of ultra-processed foods (NOVA Group 4).
can_1: Identify E950 or Acesulfame K on scanned ingredient labels.
can_2: Trigger both the sweetener and E-number information layers.
cannot_1: Assess whether the acesulfame K has been blended with aspartame to mask its metallic aftertaste.
cannot_2: Determine the presence of organic impurities below the standard 20 mg/kg purity limit.
